title: tc-switch
description: On or off for things that apply right away – label and second line, at the start or across a settings row.

placement.description: "start" (default): the switch before its label; "end": the label on the left and the switch at the row's far end

value.description: Current value; prevent tc-value-change to control it from the application.

name.description: Form field name; objects and arrays are serialized as JSON.

disabled.description: Disable editing and omit the control from form submission.
